fact: The CNDP's public register of significant control events, updated 20 January 2025, lists press-reported cases it has handled against named organisations (TLSContact Maroc, BLSMOR Services, VFS GCC Morocco, Avito, Cadi Ayyad University) with status, infractions found and referral to the public prosecutor.
title: Evénements significatifs de contrôle
publisher: Commission Nationale de Contrôle de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (CNDP)
